# EtherHive

> Quantum-proof decentralized messaging. Wallet + ENS identity. Auth via
> honesty. Post-quantum end-to-end encryption (ML-KEM-1024, ML-DSA-87) over
> an X3DH double ratchet. One name, no phone number.

Source: https://github.com/peterlodri-sec/etherhive

## What it is

- Identity = an ENS name you own. Login signs a UUID + timestamp
  (EIP-191 personal_sign), the server verifies the signer against the
  current on-chain ENS owner (Registry + Name Wrapper).
- 1:1 messages run X3DH-bootstrapped double ratchet sessions (built on
  Matrix's vodozemac), hybridized with ML-KEM-1024 — directional session
  keys derived per-side via HKDF so the server never sees plaintext.
- Honesty-auth: a 17-question honesty vector, ML-DSA-signed and hashed,
  used as a second identity check that can't be phished the way a
  password can.
- Transport: Mullvad double-hop WireGuard, Tailscale/Headscale mesh.

## Sibling ecosystem

- vaked.dev — the ecosystem hub
- music.vaked.dev — the constellation sound node
- peterl.dev — builder of loops
